recipe.visualDefinition: A classic mid-century album cover featuring a large square portrait framed by a thick, textured border, topped with a white header containing bold display typography and a two-column tracklist.
coreVisualRelationships: White header block occupying the top third of the frame
Large photographic portrait occupying the bottom two-thirds
Heavy outer border framing the entire composition
Color coordination between the subject's clothing and the display text
coreInvariants: Thick outer border with distressed texture
Two-column tracklist layout in the header
White background for all text elements
Thin white internal stroke separating the image from the border

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centered in the lower two-thirds, shown from the chest up, slightly angled toward the viewer.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bold, red display text at the top of the white header.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the red title, moves down to the tracklist, then settles on the central portrait.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant white space in the header provides breathing room for the text against the dense photographic background.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Earthy brown/maroon for the outer border.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white for the header background and internal framing line.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm orange-red for the display text and subject's clothing.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted, natural tones in the photograph contrasted with high-saturation red text.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Condensed slab serif and geometric sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Display text uses heavy, condensed slab serifs with minimal stroke contrast
Secondary text uses light-weight, wide-tracked geometric sans-serif
All text is set in uppercase
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-impact condensed slab serif paired with airy, wide-tracked sans-serif for functional lists.
graphicDevices: Distressed/weathered texture on the outer frame

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed feel of the display title.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Futura Light or Gill Sans Light
candidateDirections.reason: Captures the clean, mid-century feel of the tracklist.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square portrait of a man in a 1960s orange sweater and paisley scarf, set against a mossy stone wall. Place this image inside a thick, weathered maroon-brown border with a thin white inner stroke. Leave the top 30% of the frame as a solid white rectangle.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a bold, condensed red slab-serif title at the top left of the white area. Below it, add two columns of text in a light, wide-tracked blue-grey sans-serif font.

verificationChecks: Is the header background pure white?
Is the display text condensed and bold?
Are there two distinct columns for the secondary text?

adjustableVariables: Number of columns in the tracklist
mustRedesign: Specific artist name and song titles
Record label logos in the top right corner
Specific facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: Balanced white space in the header
avoid: Overly sharp, clean borders without texture

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the white header does not overlap the portrait.
Check that the red text matches the warmth of the subject's clothing.
Verify the outer border has a visible 'worn' texture.
Confirm all text is in uppercase.
recipe.reuseFormula: Square layout + [Textured Border Color] + [White Header Block] + [Condensed Slab Serif Title] + [Two-Column Sans-Serif List] + [Portrait Image]
